Cookie information

A simple explanation of this website’s browser behaviour.

What this site uses

The website code does not set advertising, analytics or preference cookies. It does not use browser local storage or session storage for enquiry or workbook information.

Private access and hosting

Where this site is accessed through a private hosting service, that service may use necessary authentication or security mechanisms. Those operate separately from the page interactions described here.

External services

Opening WhatsApp or an email application takes you to a separate service with its own settings and practices. Your browser settings can manage cookies and permissions for websites you visit.

Future changes

If optional analytics or advertising tools are added, this information and any required choices should be updated to reflect the tools actually used. Last updated: 22 October 2026.
